title: We Bought an INSANE Big Block Blower Engine From Australia! Toast Is Getting 1,500+ Horsepower

why_change.fact: Team concluded their own burnout-engine combo (Blueprint big blocks, EFI, 10-71) was the wrong approach vs. the Australian burnout recipe; needed an engine capable of ~1,500 hp, which Blueprint does not offer at that rating; parted on good terms

engine_origin.fact: Pulled from Heath's car (co-owner of Castlemaine Rod Shop; caption 'castle main rod shop'), one of three cars the Rod Shop brought to the Cleetus & Cars event (caption 'cleveland cars') along with Warbird and a car captioned 'kilby'; Heath's car captioned 'the real deal toronto' (likely a Holden Torana, low confidence). Engine removed in California before the car shipped home. Same combination as Warbird.

engine_state.fact: fully refreshed before Summernats; car only driven around, no skids on the fresh build

engine_builder.name: Ben (caption 'ben nogas', surname low confidence) - also built Warbird's engine

old_engine_fate.fact: Blueprint big block goes into the Freedom Factory flatbed truck; Toast's old blower/hat/ECU may be reused later for an EFI blown big block, possibly in White Trash

base_vehicle.note: Camaro per caller context; not stated in this video

engine.heads: aluminium cast heads (stated as aluminium; Warbird's said to be cast)
engine.ignition: magneto via rear mag drive with ignition box
engine.rated_hp: capable of ~1,500 hp (requirement stated; title says 1,500+)
engine.notes: most components US-made, assembled in Australia; complete 'hat to oil pan' turnkey package incl. alternator, water pump, starter

fuel.delivery: mechanical fuel injection; mechanical fuel pump driven off the cam
fuel.note: mechanical injection chosen for simplicity and burnout behavior after EFI proved challenging

cars.ecu: none required for engine (mechanical injection + magneto)

transmission.type: Powerglide, aftermarket case, with correct gear set

converter.fact: converter specified for this combination included

suspension.plan: considering rack-and-pinion front end conversion (replace steering box/idler/pitman) with upper/lower control arms, possibly cutting strut towers, to clear dry sump/alternator and reduce steering slop

install_issues.issue: rear magneto hits firewall: either cut firewall (~1 full day) or move mag drive to front with a kit costing ~$600-700 (front/cam drive conflicts with cam-driven fuel pump)
oil pan depth vs crossmember/core support; dry sump fittings may need 90s and longer lines
steering box interferes with alternator/dry-sump pump area

parts.part: Complete Castlemaine Rod Shop 540 / 14-71 / mech-injected / dry-sump engine + Powerglide + converter
parts.note: price given privately ('gave me a number'), not stated

cars.confidence: high for engine spec list; low for car names/builder surname

engine_recipes.australian_burnout_540: 540ci big block, Callies crank/rods, CP pistons, alloy heads, 14-71, mechanical methanol injection, dry sump, magneto, Powerglide
